Corehounds in Molten Core no longer despawn when they "die".
Corrected an issue where Majordomo Executus and Ragnaros would often be unkillable after a server restart or crash.

Corehounds in Molten Core no longer look for Corehounds in a radius, and instead try to see if the rest of their formation is dead. Different packs of Core Hounds will not be able to revive eachother.

Greatly improved overall consistency for the Baron Geddon encounter.
Greatly improved overall consistency for the Garr encounter.
Corrected an issue where Nefarians Bone Constructs would not use their abilities.
Nefarian will now summon his Bone Constructs at 30% health (up from 20%).
Chromaggus'' health has been increased significantly on heroic difficulty. Reminder that each Brood Affliction still increases damage dealt by 15%.
Time Lapse (The movement speed slow from standing inside chronosphere) now lasts for 10 seconds (down from 30).
Chronosphere will no longer increase damage dealt by 100%. Instead it will now increase casting and attack speed by 50%.
Corrosive Accid now lasts 21 seconds (up from 15). Acid Breath will no longer reduce targets armor by a random amount. It will now reduce targets armor by -4500. Periodic tick damage reduced by 50%.
Frost Burn now lasts 21 seconds (up from 15).
Ignite Flesh now lasts 21 seconds (down from 60).
Dark Flames now lasts 5 seconds (down from 10).
All Brood Afflictions will now last for 5 minutes (down from 10).
Brood Affliction: Black: Will no longer increase the players'' Fire Damage taken. It will now reduce the players attack power by 50%.
Brood Affliction: Green: No longer deals periodic damage. Now reduces healing taken by 25% (down from 50%).
Brood Affliction: Bronze: Will now stun the player every 10 seconds for 1 Second. (Was 4 Seconds).
Chromagus Enrage will no longer increase his damage done by 40%. He now gains 30% attack speed (up from 20%) and he will no longer grow to a size that causes him to adjust his position.

Corrected an issue where the Elemental Shields from Chromaggus would also reduce the damage of the element they increased(This left for a 20% increase from the intended 100% increase). Holy damage is no longer reduced by these shields as it is not empowered by Chromaggus.
Corrected an issue where Chromaggus would target the same area for his Frost Breath every time he used it.

Flamegor is no longer immune to slow and snare effect.

Flamegor now has the lowest health of the encounter.
Flamegor will no longer cast Shadowflame. He will use Dark Breath instead.
Ebonroc now has the second highest health of the encounter.
Ebonroc will no longer cast Dark Breath.
Ebonroc''s Shadow of Ebonroc will now last 15 seconds (up from 8) and heal him for 10000 when he lands a melee attack (down from 50000). This healing is reduced by 50% on Flexmode.
Increased Firemaw''s size by 20%.

Shadowflame''s periodic damage reduced by 90%. It still requires Onyxia Scale Cloak to prevent the effect.
Firemaw, Ebonroc and Flamegor can now be seperated by 100 yards before Stress starts to stack. Stress will still start to stack when one of the drakes dies.
Corrected an issue where it was possible for the drakes to leave their room without triggering Stress.
Corrected an issue that caused Stress to stack to fast when triggered.
Corrected an issue where all three drakes would gain their Stress Aura a few seconds into combat even when they were not seperated.
Corrected an issue where it was possible to gain loot from the boss without killing all 3 drakes.
